title: GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna list at half the token price of the GPT-5.6 models they replace
detail: OpenAI made GPT-6 Sol and GPT-6 Luna available on September 22, 2026. On the OpenAI pricing page, standard short-context rates are $2.00 input / $0.20 cached input / $10.00 output per million tokens for GPT-6 Sol, and $0.10 / $0.01 / $0.50 for GPT-6 Luna. The same page still lists their predecessors at $4.00 / $0.40 / $20.00 for GPT-5.6 Sol and $0.20 / $0.02 / $1.20 for GPT-5.6 Luna, so Sol input and output both fall by half and Luna output falls from $1.20 to $0.50. GPT-6 Astra, released earlier, remains at $10.00 / $1.00 / $50.00. Long-context variants are listed at higher rates than the short-context rates quoted here. VentureBeat reported that an OpenAI spokesperson called these permanent prices rather than promotional or introductory pricing. No retirement date was announced for the GPT-5.6 models, which remain listed.
impact: Anyone already running GPT-5.6 Sol or Luna workloads can move to the GPT-6 equivalent and pay half the input and output rate, with cached input dropping in the same proportion. The GPT-5.6 models keep working at their current listed rates, so this is an opt-in saving that requires changing the model name in your calls, not an automatic reduction to your existing bill.
